name: Lincoln County, MS
findings: Lincoln County has 62 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lincoln County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lincoln County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lincoln County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
